payload.title: Exact cleanup inventory — Codex desktop app (Windows)

installed_app.supported_uninstall: Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Codex > Uninstall, or: Remove-AppxPackage -Package OpenAI.Codex_26.1007.2314.0_x64__2p2nqsd0c76g0
installed_app.uninstall_effect: Removes application binary only. Does not touch user data in %APPDATA%, %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenAI, or ~/.codex.

generated_residuals_removable.why_recreatable: Contains only rg.exe; the active version 2e5e00daee91c61d has the full binary set. Leftover from an incomplete update.
generated_residuals_removable.deletion_effect: Removes dead files. No functional impact.

generated_residuals_removable.why_recreatable: Re-downloaded by the app on next launch/install.
generated_residuals_removable.deletion_effect: App re-downloads on next start. Temporary loss of offline capability.
Clears cached web state. May log out web sessions inside the app.
Slower first launch while plugins re-download.

preserve_do_not_touch: ~/.codex/config.toml — active config including the plugin fix; backup at config.toml.bak-medic-20261010
irreversible_steps: Deleting ~/.codex/sessions/ without backup: 7.4GB of history unrecoverable.
Full reinstall without backing up config.toml: loses the legacy-plugin disable fix.
payload.recovery_limits: MSIX uninstall is clean but does not remove user data (by design). If the app's internal Electron state is the fault, uninstall alone may not clear %APPDATA%\Codex — manual deletion of the profile directory may be needed as a separate step.

transport_boundary.ssh_transport: Windows OpenSSH Server — system component, independent of the Codex MSIX package.
transport_boundary.uninstall_impact: None. Removing the Codex app does not affect SSH connectivity.
transport_boundary.scope_confirmation: SSH transport is out of scope and will not be touched by any cleanup step.

proposed_sequence: 6. Only if still broken: MSIX uninstall + reinstall, preserving ~/.codex.
payload.not_executed: Inventory and proposal only. No deletions performed.
